title: Studio layout skeleton: the 48 px three-column shell header, one 240 px rail and one 300 px inspector aside shared by all four pillars, and the item-header + tab-row scaffold each pillar renders its existing content into (supersedes #12447, #12448, #12449)
body:
## Source

Epic objectstack-ai/objectui#12446, decisions 1, 2 and 3. This card is the structural half of the redesign: the shell header, the rail and the inspector aside that all four pillars share, and the content-column scaffold (item header row + tab row + body) each pillar renders its existing content into. The pillar cards (#12450, #12451, #12454, #12455, #12456) restyle what goes inside that scaffold; the read-only card (#12453) adds its two signals to it. It supersedes #12447 (shell header), #12448 (shared rail) and #12449 (shared inspector aside), which close as duplicates of this card.

## Ruling

Maintainer, in the epic PM session on 2026-10-15, verbatim:

> 我建议你先派一张整体布局的卡，你负责改了。

Under that ruling the epic PM session (`session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff`) implements this one card itself — the maintainer's explicit per-card exception to the rule that the PM seat writes no code. The remaining children stay with the `domain:ui` lane and are accepted by the epic PM against the reference artboards.

## Target

Measured on objectui main `a2225f91`. The numbers below are the ones every other child cites; the artboards under `docs/design/studio-redesign/` (landing in a separate docs-only PR) show them as pixels.

1. **Shell header, 48 px, a CSS grid `1fr auto 1fr`.** Left: the home icon button (32 px), then the `PackageSwitcher` trigger rendered as an app chip — a 24 px rounded tile with the package's app icon on its color (the Home tile's icon and color; a generic package glyph when the package has no app), the name at 13 px / 600, a chevron. Center: the pillars as a segmented control — a 3 px padded muted track, 28 px items, the active item on the card surface with a 1 px shadow and its icon in the primary color. Right: Changes as an outline button whose pending count is an 18 px primary pill; Publish unchanged in behavior. The "·" separator span goes. The More overflow stays exactly as objectui#11794 ruled until decision A on the epic is answered (that is #12452's card); the segmented control simply renders it as its last item.
2. **One rail, `StudioRail.tsx`, 240 px**, used by Data, Automations, Interfaces and Access: a 44 px header row (11 px uppercase heading with 0.06 em tracking, an 18 px count pill, a 28 px add button at the right that the pillar passes in or omits), a 32 px search input, 32 px rows with a 16 px glyph slot, a truncating 13 px label and a trailing slot, group-header rows of 28 px with a chevron and 12 px child indent, an empty-group row, an optional legend slot. Active row: primary-soft background, primary text, 500 weight. Each pillar's rows keep their current content, icons, search behavior, badges and separators; only the frame and the measurements change. The Data rail's "Read-only" footer is removed here (its signal returns in #12453).
3. **One inspector aside, `StudioInspector.tsx`, 300 px**, at the right of every pillar's content body: a header with an 11 px uppercase eyebrow (the kind), a 15 px / 600 title, an 11 px mono id and a 28 px close button; a 16 px padded body the pillar fills; a pinned 12 px muted footer "Edits save as drafts. Publish the package to apply them." (one new i18n key in every locale). The Automations `w-72` aside, the Interfaces "Canvas / Properties" tab pair with its `w-9` icon strip, and the Data column and field inspector mounts all render through it; below a 1000 px content row the aside folds into the existing sheet in every pillar (the objectui#11795 narrow-row behavior, today Automations-only).
4. **Content-column scaffold in each pillar**: an item header row (18 px top and 24 px side padding; a 32 px primary-soft icon tile; the item's label at 18 px / 600; its api name as an 11 px mono chip; a 12 px muted meta slot; a right-aligned actions slot), then a 36 px tab row with a 2 px primary underline on the active tab, then the body. The pillar-specific second band retires and its content moves into the scaffold without redesign: Automations' Enabled switch and "Off by default" sentence go to the header's actions slot (the sentence as the switch's title); Interfaces' "Home · Dashboard" becomes the header's label plus a kind chip; Access' "Permission matrix" band becomes the header's meta slot ("Objects × CRUD · field-level R/W") with Explain access in the actions slot. The Data pillar's object header moves from above the rail into the scaffold. Today's tab strips (Records / Form / Advanced ▾; Layout / Preview stays inside the Form body) render in the tab row with their current names and behavior; flattening Advanced is #12450's card and decision B.
5. **Shared constants** in `studio-tokens.ts`: the sizes above as named Tailwind class strings, so the pillar cards compose them instead of restating numbers.

## File surface

`packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (shell header, the four pillars' rail and aside mounts, the four item headers and tab rows, the three retired bands), new `StudioRail.tsx`, `StudioInspector.tsx`, `studio-tokens.ts` in the same folder, `ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` (header only), `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (the footer sentence; retired band keys in every locale).

## Acceptance

1. A screenshot of each pillar at 1280 px, light and dark, with HotCRM open: the rail's heading, search and first row, the item header's title and the tab row sit at the same y in all four; the aside's header sits at the same x and y in the three pillars that show one.
2. The segmented control's center is the viewport's center within 4 px with a 14-character package name on the left and "Changes" plus a count on the right.
3. No full-width band between the shell header and the rail in any pillar; Automations' switch still toggles `status` through the same confirmation and refusal paths (`AutomationsPillar.authorRefusal-11785`, `heldIncomplete-11786`, `StudioDesignSurface.flowStatusTruth-11779` green).
4. The narrow-row fold works in all four pillars (`AutomationsPillar.narrowRow-11795` extended to one more pillar).
5. Every test under `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` green; tests that pinned the retired bands, the "·" separator, the "Changes · N" text or the `w-9` strip are updated in the same PR, each ablated once.
6. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test`, `lint`, `build` green; `pnpm check:i18n` green for the key changes.

## Constraints

- Tailwind utilities and theme tokens only; no inline style, so `.dark` stays a real variant.
- Existing `data-testid`s and i18n keys stay; new ids: `studio-rail-data`, `studio-rail-automations`, `studio-rail-interfaces`, `studio-rail-access`, `studio-inspector`.
- No pillar body restyle, no read-only consolidation, no nav-kind picker, no flow grouping in this card.
- The objectstack console pin bump is a follow-up outside this subtree.

Supersedes: #12447, #12448, #12449 (closed as duplicates of this card).

Parent: objectstack-ai/objectui#12446
